final: SELECT AVG(avg_pt), AVG(avg_tat_difference) FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ID)
